title: Portability effort must remove specific exit work
method: Synthetic exit effort=12+18+20+10=60; wrapper=15+3×6=33. If only 12 integration days are avoided, direct excess is 21 days; other benefits and residual exit work need separate treatment.
alt: Portability effort must remove specific exit work: Full exit estimate 60 engineer-days, Three-year wrapper 33 engineer-days, Integration saved 12 engineer-days. Illustrative inputs.
